papers.title: Influence of Inherent Surface and Internal Defects on Mechanical Properties of Additively Manufactured Ti6Al4V Alloy: Comparison between Selective Laser Melting and Electron Beam Melting
papers.abstract: Additive manufacture (AM) appears to be the most suitable technology to produce sophisticated, high quality, lightweight parts from Ti6Al4V alloy. However, the fatigue life of AM parts is of concern. In our study, we focused on a comparison of two techniques of additive manufacture-selective laser melting (SLM) and electron beam melting (EBM)-in terms of the mechanical properties during both static and dynamic loading. All of the samples were untreated to focus on the influence of surface condition inherent to SLM and EBM. The EBM samples were studied in the as-built state, while SLM was followed by heat treatment. The resulting similarity of microstructures led to comparable mechanical properties in tension, but, due to differences in surface roughness and specific internal defects, the fatigue strength of the EBM samples reached only half the value of the SLM samples. Higher surface roughness that is inherent to EBM contributed to multiple initiations of fatigue cracks, while only one crack initiated on the SLM surface. Also, facets that were formed by an intergranular cleavage fracture were observed in the EBM samples.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了增材制造钛合金的疲劳性能与表面粗糙度，但与生物医学植入物的应力遮挡、骨整合等方向无直接关联。

summary_zh.motivation: 对比SLM与EBM工艺下Ti6Al4V合金的力学性能差异
summary_zh.method: 对SLM（热处理后）和EBM（原态）样品进行静态拉伸与疲劳实验
summary_zh.result: EBM样品因表面粗糙度较高导致疲劳强度仅为SLM的一半
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸与疲劳试验数据对比验证

summary_en.motivation: This study compares the mechanical properties of Ti6Al4V fabricated by SLM and EBM, focusing on the influence of inherent surface and internal defects.
summary_en.method: Tensile and fatigue tests were conducted on as-built EBM and heat-treated SLM samples, along with fractographic analysis.
summary_en.result: EBM samples exhibited fatigue strength only half that of SLM, attributed to higher surface roughness and multiple crack initiation sites.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing and fracture surface characterization.

summary_en.motivation: To understand the atomic-scale structural evolution during selective laser melting of metallic glasses.
summary_en.method: Molecular dynamics simulations of the rapid solidification process in Cu50Zr50.
summary_en.result: Revealed the atomic rearrangements and glass formation kinetics under SLM conditions.
summary_en.validation: Computational model with no experimental validation.
